description: Limitations of Fourier Neural Operators for Nonlinear Structural Response Prediction under Earthquake Excitation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Kexun Li, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This project is the reproducibility data and code package for the manuscript “Limitations of Fourier Neural Operators for Nonlinear Structural Response Prediction under Earthquake Excitation” (Kexun Li and Luis Ceferino). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Fourier Neural Operators, nonlinear structural response, machine learning, surrogate modeling. Published 2026-07-23. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
